explanation: Generated 3 EXCLURAD input files for eta electroproduction (ep->e'peta) using the eta-channel configuration (model=3 EtaMAID-2023, ivec=1 recoil proton, bmom=6.53 CLAS12, vcut=0.166). Request: W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi* from 0 to 345 degrees in 25 points. The Fortran reader limits each file to 10 kinematic points, so the 25 points were chunked into 3 files: chunk1=10 pts (phi*=0..129.375), chunk2=10 pts (phi*=143.75..273.125), chunk3=5 pts (phi*=287.5..345.0), with uniform step 345/24=14.375 degrees. All other parameters set to eta-channel defaults per spp.inc/mpintp.inc and README. The trailing legacy line '0error detected by nag library routine d01fce - ifail = 2' is required by the parser. No build/test possible (read-only source, no compiler).
